Mod.Name: Difficulty Scaling
Mod.Author: Overgrowth Online
Mod.Description: Adjust enemy strength and equipment to the party and its performance. The host selects scaling in Difficulty and configures the rates for each lobby mode. Peers match this mod and its network schema. Session saves preserve settings, encounter pressure, and earned difficulty increases.

LobbySetting.label: Active time
LobbySetting.description: Increase enemy difficulty as active play time passes.

LobbySetting.label: Level or match completion
LobbySetting.description: Increase enemy difficulty when a level or match is completed.

LobbySetting.label: Performance scaling
LobbySetting.description: Adjust difficulty after wins, party wipes or both.

LobbySetting.label: Performance rate
LobbySetting.description: Set the size of each performance adjustment.
